result.summary: Found 2 issues: one major missing image and one minor text truncation issue.

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' section shows a broken/missing image placeholder for Tokumaru Ramen Bar. The image failed to load and is displaying a generic broken image icon.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the restaurant image URL is valid and accessible. Implement a proper fallback image to display when the primary image fails to load.

issues.description: The third restaurant name in the 'Fastest near you' section ('Trattoria Piccol...') is being truncated due to insufficient horizontal space, cutting off the full name.
issues.suggestion: Either allow text to wrap to a second line, reduce font size, or ensure the card width is sufficient to display the full restaurant name. Alternatively, use an ellipsis with a tooltip showing the full name.
